```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

`prepare_glbfp()` prepares the grid counts once, so they can be reused for
predictions and leave-one-out diagnostics.

```{r}
library(GLBFP)

set.seed(2026)
observations <- matrix(rnorm(300), ncol = 1)
model <- prepare_glbfp(observations, b = 0.5, m = 2, min_vals = -4)

predict(model, matrix(c(-1, 0, 1), ncol = 1))
scores <- compute_Di(model)
summary(scores)
```

The grid and bandwidth remain fixed when an observation is removed.
The score describes local self-support; it is not an outlier probability.
See `?prepare_glbfp` and `?compute_Di` for the available options.
